text:
Elena K.: Heads-up — I'll push a small min-scale tweak to the aurora GPU pool tonight at 21:30 PT. It's only a scaling policy change (min_replicas 2 -> 3) to reduce cold-start latency during peak bursts.

Ryan P.: SGTM. What's the smoke plan?

Elena K.: Smoke steps:
- run the test-runner workload against aurora (100 concurrent short gen requests)
- monitor p50/p95 and error rate for 15m
- if p95 > 800ms or errors > 1% -> rollback
I'll kick off the test from my laptop and post results here.

Maya S.: I'll be watching dashboards and tracing. I'll join @21:25 PT and stay till +30m after deploy. Ping me if you see errors :eyes: 

Samir V.: Can you paste the TF diff so I can quick-approve? I want to confirm no other fields change.

Elena K.: Sure — snippet:
```
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "aurora" {
  name         = "aurora"
  autoscaling_policy = {
    min_replicas = 3
    max_replicas = 40
    scale_window = "60s"
  }
}
```
Will open PR now. Deploy-bot will run plan+apply after review.

deploy-bot: PR 4827 opened by @elena — terraform plan succeeded. Merge window: 21:30 PT -> 21:45 PT.

Ryan P.: If anything looks off, what's rollback? 

Elena K.: Rollback plan:
1) Revert PR -> auto-apply old tf state
2) If apply fails, scale aurora manually to min_replicas=2 via infra-console (ops-only)
3) Notify customers on status page if we exceed error thresholds for >15m
Should be low-risk.

ops-bot: Alert rule assigned to Maya S. (aurora-pool latency monitor). Thresholds: p50>200ms, p95>800ms, errors>1%.

Maya S.: I'll post the smoke results here. @samir please do a quick glance on the PR when ready.

Samir V.: Will do, aiming to review in next 10m.

Elena K.: Thanks — starting the merge at 21:30 PT. I'll post `test-runner` logs and a short pass/fail summary.
